_about: Cyclohexanone (1) + Toluene (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of cyclohexanone, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of cyclohexanone, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: J. Gao, K. Zhang, D. Xu, L. Zhang, N. Chen, C. Li, Isobaric Vapor Liquid Equilibrium for Binary Systems of Cyclohexanone + Benzene, Cyclohexanone + Toluene, and Cyclohexanone + p-Xylene at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 62 (2017) 1948-1954
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 3, 4. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0027. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
